evidence.coverage: Saved tasks cover CSV processing, log analysis and visualization; domain names and concrete work descriptions reviewed.
evidence.structure_and_scope: Unique linked records and valid parent graph; substantive executable decomposition distinguished from milestone containers. No arbitrary numeric effort cutoff.
evidence.scope_preserved: Required work retained; parent estimates after real child decomposition are not treated as scope hiding.
evidence.delivery_truth: No final answer; persisted partial work cannot establish completed delivery.

initial_arguments.name: Implement normalization, dedupe & upsert
initial_arguments.details:
Normalize values (trim, case-fold emails, parse dates, map country/state codes), compute a natural key per customer, and upsert with last-write-wins on a source-modified timestamp. Re-ingesting the same file must be a no-op.

Output: ingesting the same CSV twice leaves row counts unchanged.

initial_arguments.name: Build log parse & normalize job
initial_arguments.details:
Run the parsers over landed log files and write structured rows: timestamp, level, service, request_id, latency_ms, status_code, message. Handle multi-line stack traces by attaching them to the preceding entry. Track parse success/failure counts per file.

Output: a day of sample logs lands in the structured table with a printed success rate.

initial_arguments.name: Build chart component library
initial_arguments.details:
Implement line, bar, stacked area, KPI tile, and data-table components on top of the chosen charting library. One shared theme (colors, fonts, axis/grid defaults, number and date formatters). Each component takes a typed data prop and has no data-fetching logic.

Output: gallery page renders every component with sample data.

limitations: Same coordinator; prior scores exposed, not independent validation.
Qualitative scope is not measured implementation effort.
Analyzer heuristics and stored complexity fields are different quantities.
Missing dependency fields remain unknown, not zero.
